units: meters relative to intersection center; +x = E, +y = N; heading in radians, counter-clockwise from +x

model.format: approach: per step {dir: [phase, confidence, committed]}; lane: per step {lane_id: [phase, confidence]} for lanes with evidence. UNKNOWN = no nearby traffic (or first 1 s warm-up); NONE = no lights that way. ego: per step [phase, confidence, committed] for the Waymo car's own lane (null if it isn't approaching a light) -> use this for the big 'your light' panel.
